title: Entitlement Snapshot v1
description: LIVE as of Phase 6, but not exposed as a standalone endpoint -- this exact shape is embedded as the `entitlements` field inside every signed assertion payload (see signed-assertion-design.md). Matches app/licensing_service/entitlements.py::resolve_entitlements()'s output (include_source=False, the client-facing form -- the internal _source field is never included here).
description_note: Keys are entitlement_code strings (e.g. 'max_devices', 'backup_enabled'); values are typed per the entitlement's value_type (boolean/integer/string/list/date). Deny-by-default: every known entitlement code is always present, with a safe default value if nothing resolved it.

additionalProperties.description: One of: boolean, integer, string, array of strings, or an ISO-8601 date string (or null for an unresolved date-typed entitlement).
